findings.source_quote: I the LORD search the heart, I try the reins… –Jeremiah 17:10.
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the phrase so it conveys the Biblical sense: for example “Mimi BWANA ninachunguza moyo, nachekesha/kichunguza matawi/mwendelezo wa nia” is wrong. Better: “Mimi BWANA ninatafiti moyo, ninajaribu mawazo ya moyo/kujitathmini kwa mioyo” or use the standard Kiswahili Bible wording: “Mimi, BWANA, ninaangalia moyo, ninajaribu viwango vya moyo.” Preserve the parallel structure.
